$comment: Chrona operational failure boundaries. Expected outcomes (an invalid label, a storage failure the kernel reports, a stale storage result) remain typed engine outcomes shown as ordinary page content and are not Aegis faults. See src/Chrona.Application/Boundary.fs.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (kernel verification slice)
boundaries.$comment: Every kernel message is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (Wire.handle). A message that is not the Limen shape the engine relies on (including an unsupported protocol version) is MESSAGE_INVALID; a kernel without the Storage effect, or a result or fact for something the engine never requested or negotiated, is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Programming defects (an event name kernel-slice.html sends that the engine does not know) keep Aegis fail-loud semantics and surface as a Limen bridge error.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (Chrona application)
boundaries.$comment: Every kernel message for web/index.html is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (App.handle), classified by the same Boundary.classify. A message that is not the Limen shape is MESSAGE_INVALID; a kernel without the Navigation, Http or Storage effect, a sign-in request when the chrona.host pack was not negotiated, or a result or fact for something the engine never requested (an unknown correlation id, a result of the wrong kind, a fact from a pack other than chrona.host) is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. An Http or Storage result for the deployment's configuration or for Fides' sign-in client is an expected outcome: an unreadable configuration is a misconfigured deployment shown on the page, and an exchange or provider refusal is a sign-in notice, never a fault. An unexpected failure inside Fides' client surfaces here as UNEXPECTED. A refused entry, an overlap or an archived reference is a typed domain diagnostic shown beside its form, never a fault. Programming defects (an event name the engine does not define) keep fail-loud semantics.

boundaries.name: Browser localStorage
boundaries.$comment: The kernel performs the Storage effects the engine requests. Their outcomes (including unavailable and quota-exceeded) cross the Limen protocol as explicit typed StorageResults; this declaration does not pretend the .NET Aegis runtime guards JavaScript localStorage.

boundaries.name: Browser timing, environment, clipboard, print and host (limen.schedule, limen.environment, Clipboard, chrona.print, chrona.host)
boundaries.$comment: The kernel performs the timer's wake-ups, describes the browser's time zone, writes exports to the clipboard and opens the print dialog. Their outcomes cross the Limen protocol as typed results; a kernel that does not offer one degrades visibly (no display refresh; UTC shown as the zone; 'this browser did not allow copying'; the browser's own Print still prints Folio's document) rather than failing. chrona.host keeps Fides' sign-in state in this tab's session storage (a failure reads as absent, and Fides keeps the session in memory), leaves for the identity provider over https only, replaces the address bar only within this origin, and relays token-free sign-in messages between the origin's tabs.

persistence.fallbackBehaviour: Aegis sink failures are contained by the configured fallback; Chrona does not treat diagnostic persistence as business success.
persistence.retentionPolicy: No durable Aegis sink is configured; in the browser the standard-error sink writes to the console.
